name: Crocodilians
description: Crocodilians are large semi-aquatic carnivore Reptiles: crocodiles, alligators and caimans.$(br2)They wait almost hidden in rivers and swamps, with only their eyes and nostrils above the water, and ambush animals that come to drink or cross.$(br2)They lay their eggs in nests on land, and the mother guards them until they hatch.
